edits.hebrew: ‎ומנלן דבעינן זביחה לשמה‏ - לכתחילה, דאי ממוצא שפתיך לא מיפרשי ביה עבודות:
edits.english: From where do we derive that we require slaughter for its sake - [We need to know this] ab initio; for if we were to derive it from 'that which has gone out of your lips,' the sacrificial rites themselves would not be explicitly stated there.
